% Removed in rewrite 2026-09-25: largest-advantage galleries (4 datasets + 2 plug-in; generated by figures/src/make_qual_best*.py via tables/generated/qual_best_*.tex, left in place) and the surgical and Language-Table random galleries; one random DROID gallery and the failure cases remain.
\paragraph{Largest-advantage windows per benchmark.} For every forecasting benchmark with finished \ours{}, Direct and AR
runs (lowest common seed), the next figures show three held-out windows chosen by a fixed rule: over all test windows
(stride 2) we compute each method's step-10 feature MSE and the true change $\|\Z_{t+10}-\Z_t\|^2$; among windows in the
top 50\% of true change we rank by the gain $1-\mathrm{err}_{\text{\ours{}}}/\min(\mathrm{err}_{\text{Direct}},\mathrm{err}_{\text{AR}})$
and keep the top three from distinct episodes (\cref{fig:qual-best-droid,fig:qual-best-droid-cam2,fig:qual-best-openh-hamlyn,fig:qual-best-language-table}; DROID camera~2 uses the camera-1 models and decoder zero-shot). Every method is shown on the same window and frame, with one error scale
per dataset; decoded forecasts use the decoder of \cref{app:pixel}. These are selected best-case examples, not typical
ones: the random galleries follow, and aggregate results are in the tables.

\IfFileExists{submission_folder/tables/generated/qual_best_plugin_macros.tex}{\input{submission_folder/tables/generated/qual_best_plugin_macros.tex}}{}
\paragraph{Largest-advantage windows for the plug-in heads.} The same rule compares each published model with and without
the \ours{} head on identical inputs (\cref{app:plugin}). For V-JEPA~2-AC on DROID we rank all test windows at $k{=}10$
(the head lowers error on \qbWinVjepa\% of them) and show token forecasts in a PCA shared per window
(\cref{fig:qual-best-vjepa2ac}). For DINO-WM we use the 200 open-loop validation rollouts behind the step-5 errors of
\cref{app:plugin} and show each model's own decoder at step 5 (the last rollout step, where the gap is largest). On PushT the head
wins \qbWinPusht\% of rollouts (\cref{fig:qual-best-dinowm-pusht}); on Wall, where it raises the mean error
(\cref{sec:plugin}), it wins \qbWinWall\% of rollouts, so no selected examples are shown there.

\paragraph{Random galleries and failure cases.} \Cref{fig:gallery-droid,fig:gallery-surgical,fig:gallery-langtable}
show random held-out episodes of DROID, the seven surgical tasks and Language-Table: for each episode, the true frames
and the decoded forecasts of AR, Direct and \ours{} at $k\in\{1,3,5,10\}$, with \ours{}'s gate and transport field
beside the observed frame. \Cref{fig:failures} shows the opposite end: the test windows with the largest \ours{} error
on DROID and Hamlyn, with the per-patch error, the transport field and the gate. They are discussed in
\cref{app:discussion}.
